items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: One experience I witnessed with my own eyes was an occasion when Coltrane was playing with Miles Davis – one of his high profile bands that was recorded beautifully, the band that included John Coltrane, Miles, Philly Joe Jones, Paul Chambers and . . .

ctx.x: I think his genius reflected the fact that he was a practice-aholic. One experience I witnessed with my own eyes was an occasion when Coltrane was playing with Miles Davis – one of his high profile bands that was recorded beautifully, the band that included John Coltrane, Miles, Philly Joe Jones, Paul Chambers and . . .
